{{Top|leg}}
The '''District 36 Museum of Art''' was an art [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located in [[District 36]], one of the fifty-two districts&mdash;vertically-stacked levels&mdash;of the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] and its [[Eternal Empire]]. The anarchist and bomber known as [[Kaliyo Djannis|Firebrand]] destroyed the museum shortly after arriving at the Spire, earning her a reputation as a dangerous and fashionable terrorist.
